description.value: Delhi Delite is an Indian restaurant and sweets shop occupying a unit in a commercial complex in Surrey's south end, offering indoor dining with air conditioning. The pairing of a full restaurant menu with a sweets counter sets it apart from a typical curry house and gives cyclists the option of a substantial meal or a quick sweet pick-me-up. OSM data notes wheelchair accessibility and card payments accepted.
